title: Tour Party: Sotsugyou Ryokou ni Ikou
native_title: ツアー・パーティー ～卒業旅行にいこう～
overview:
Tour Party: Sotsugyou Ryokou ni Ikou is a romance-themed board game set during a school graduation trip. Up to five players each select a character and a partner of the opposite gender from a selection of eight male and eight female characters, then take turns spinning a roulette to move around the game board. The goal is to land on the same space as your partner to first introduce yourself, then to invite them on dates and finally to confess your love to them.

Each space on the game board represents a specific type of date spot, and each character has specific date types that they like best; landing on certain spaces can also trigger events which will increase a character's stats or award cards. Cards can be used to give that player a benefit or hinder other players, and some allow the player to trigger certain types of special date events. The goal of the game is to raise your partner's affection level as high as possible, then meet them on a specific space to confess your love to them and win the game.
